# ADR-<NNNN>: <short title>

- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Status:** proposed | accepted | superseded by ADR-<NNNN>
- **Phase:** <N>

## Context
What problem or spec conflict forced a decision. Include measurements or listening results if they drove it.

## Decision
What we will do, stated precisely (types, return values, folders, defaults, tolerances).

## Alternatives considered
Each option with its main pro and con.

## Consequences
What changes in the code and specs; what becomes easier or harder; which tests or scenarios change.

## Spec updates
Which sections of `docs/specs/` this overrides.
